user.title: Set up Priority State
user.description: Add a Priority State instance. Rules will control this light based on entity states. Optionally choose mobile devices to show the active state as a Live Activity.

change_light.title: Change target light
change_light.description: Select which light the rules will control.

notifications.title: Configure live notifications
notifications.description: Choose the mobile devices that should receive the Live Activity. The same activity is updated on each device.

add_rule.title: Add a rule
add_rule.description: When the watched entity is `on`, the light will change to this color.

data_description.priority: Lower numbers win when multiple watched entities are on.
data_description.enabled: Disabled rules are ignored without deleting them.

data_description.priority: Lower numbers win when multiple watched entities are on.
data_description.enabled: Disabled rules are ignored without deleting them.

select_edit_rule.title: Edit a rule
select_edit_rule.description: Choose a rule to update. Rules are sorted by priority.

select_delete_rule.title: Delete a rule
select_delete_rule.description: Choose the rule you want to delete.

debug_mode.title: Debug mode
debug_mode.description: When enabled, detailed logs are written to home-assistant.log for troubleshooting.

clear_rules.title: Clear all rules
clear_rules.description: Are you sure you want to delete **all** rules?

error.duplicate_entity: A rule for this entity already exists

remove_rule.name: Remove rule
remove_rule.description: Remove a rule by its ID

clear_rules.name: Clear all rules
clear_rules.description: Remove all rules and turn off the target light
